_comment: Screenshot / Live Stream module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_note_binary: Image data is sent as TWO consecutive WebSocket messages: first a JSON 'frame_meta', then one BINARY message (raw JPEG bytes as ArrayBuffer). The receiver must pair them in order.

screenshot_once._desc: Request a single screenshot from one or more agents

stream_start._desc: Start a continuous screen stream at the given FPS and JPEG quality

frame_meta._desc: Sent immediately BEFORE the binary JPEG frame. Contains bounding box coordinates (x, y, w, h) and keyframe signal. is_keyframe is true if frame is a keyframe (full state); false if it only contains changed bounding box area relative to previous frame. Agent sends keyframe every 30 frames (KeyframeInterval) or when stream starts. Controller receiving keyframe resets canvas; non-keyframe applies partial diff rendering.

binary_frame._desc: Raw JPEG bytes (ArrayBuffer). Always follows a frame_meta with matching seq. Not JSON — shown here only for documentation.
